## Go / No-Go decision
- **Decision: Narrow Go**
- Rationale: Pair count (538) meets Narrow-Go threshold; awaiting full model-error comparison and soft-mode evidence for Full Go. Top-50 Jaccard indicates rank instability.

## Evidence for the decision
- 538 Tier 0-1 pairs exist, so the dataset can support a benchmark/audit paper.
- Cross-protocol Frobenius disagreement is measured; median values are in the report above.
- Rank stability is quantified with top-k Jaccard and Kendall tau.

## Counter-evidence / limitations
- PMR cannot be computed in Phase 0-4 because no audited in-source model errors were extracted/reproduced.
- Soft-mode sensitivity analysis requires PiezoJet strict-factor intersection with MP pairs; not completed in this minimal audit.
- Only T2C-Flow pre-processed tensors were used; raw source Voigt conventions were not independently audited from source downloads.
